source_dict.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
curl --fail --location --retry 3 https://github.com/MCC45TR/uke-linux-hardware-support/releases/download/copr-migration-archive-20261020/uke-speaker-firmware-3.0.304.0-1.fc46.src.rpm -o input.src.rpm
printf '%s\n' 'ddded730ac0a182f3006009ab9524768c0899a219ef532d90bee6e5807eab9b3  input.src.rpm' | sha256sum -c -
rpm2cpio input.src.rpm > input.cpio
cpio -t --quiet < input.cpio | awk '/^\/|(^|\/)\.\.($|\/)/{bad=1}END{exit bad}'
cpio -idm --quiet --no-absolute-filenames < input.cpio
rm input.src.rpm input.cpio
specs=(*.spec); test ${#specs[@]} = 1
test "$(awk '/^Name:/{print $2;exit}' "${specs[0]}")" = uke-speaker-firmware
sed -i 's/^Release:.*/Release: 2%{?dist}/' "${specs[0]}"
source_dict.builddeps: bash curl coreutils rpm-build cpio gawk

#!/bin/bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
revision=b37f97ecbbb54641d449e8808cfebeb0d0f17305
[[ $(rpm --eval '%{_host_cpu}') == aarch64 ]]
git init source
git -C source remote add origin https://github.com/MCC45TR/uke-linux-hardware-support.git
git -C source fetch --depth=1 origin "$revision"
git -C source checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD
[[ $(git -C source rev-parse HEAD) == "$revision" ]]
fedora_version=$(rpm --eval '%{fedora}')
[[ $fedora_version =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]
printf '%%dist .fc%s\n' "$fedora_version" > "$HOME/.rpmmacros"
make -C source/uke-platform-runtime srpm outdir="$PWD/stage"
mapfile -t archives < <(find stage/rpmbuild/SRPMS -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.src.rpm')
[[ ${#archives[@]} == 1 ]]
source_rpm=$(realpath "${archives[0]}")
[[ $(rpm -qp --qf '%{NAME} %{VERSION}\n' "$source_rpm") == 'uke-battery-observer 1.4.1' ]]
rpm2cpio "$source_rpm" | cpio -t > members
! grep -Eq '^/|(^|/)\.\.(/|$)' members
mkdir result
cd result
rpm2cpio "$source_rpm" | cpio -idm --no-absolute-filenames
source_dict.builddeps: git make rpm-build redhat-rpm-config systemd-rpm-macros tar xz cpio coreutils grep findutils
